## Summary

Registration now sends a welcome email through the app's background queue instead of inline:

- **`bunx guren add queue` / `bunx guren add mail`** scaffolded `app/Providers/QueueProvider.ts` and `app/Providers/MailProvider.ts` (wired `QUEUE_CONNECTION`→`sync`/`memory` and `MAIL_MAILER`→`log`/`memory` drivers), plus registered both `CoreQueueServiceProvider`/`QueueProvider` and `CoreMailServiceProvider`/`MailProvider` in `src/app.ts`.
- **`app/Providers/MailProvider.ts`** was edited so the manager's default `from` address reads `MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS`/`MAIL_FROM_NAME` from `.env` instead of the scaffold's hardcoded placeholder.
- **`app/Mail/WelcomeMail.ts`** (renamed from the generated sample) builds the subject `Welcome to <APP_NAME>, <name>!` and a plain-text greeting.
- **`app/Jobs/SendWelcomeEmailJob.ts`** (renamed from the generated sample) looks the user up by id and sends `WelcomeMail` via the global mail manager; `app/Providers/QueueProvider.ts` registers it.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/Auth/RegisterController.ts`** now calls `await SendWelcomeEmailJob.dispatch({ userId: user.id })` right after `User.create(...)` — after this line only on a successful registration, so a refused signup (validation error, duplicate email) never reaches it.
- **`tests/RegisterController.test.ts`** (new) swaps in `fakeQueue()`/`fakeMail()` via `setQueueDriver`/`setMailManager`, then verifies: registration redirects to `/dashboard` with exactly one job queued and nothing sent yet; running that job (`processJob`) delivers exactly one email with the right recipient/subject; a duplicate-email registration queues and sends nothing.

`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (4/4 tests, including the two pre-existing ones).
